items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So, now after we'd go around for the Harry Joe Brown, Junior and his partner, the real estatesman from Westchester, Hustus, they wants to add another speed to the show

ctx.x: That's how I started to call them the on-the-town dancers these names, you see. Good Father and -- well, they liked it see. At least -- because the audience -- it was entertaining to the audience, you see.

So, now after we'd go around for the Harry Joe Brown, Junior and his partner, the real estatesman from Westchester, Hustus, they wants to add another speed to the show, you understand, and they wants to prolong it, you know. So, instead of two hours they wanted us to do two hours and a half.

So, we got to get up there and reproduce. So, that's what we did. And we happened to get these virtuso musicians, you know, like jazz -- Tiny Grimes, Professor Trevorson, you see, and Jerry Citron, and Pete Peterson, you know. And we already had about three others. Well, it was a combo, you know. And -- but we had to change the name. They changed the name of the show, right. Now all of the critics that wrote about this show, most of the news -- even the Christian Science Monitor, they wrote about it. I mean it…
